title_zh: 考试是恶魔吗？——牛津全灵学院的“世上最难考试”
lead_zh: 牛津全灵学院的入学考试被称为“世上最难的考试”，其标志性的一词作文题（“Time”“Memory”“Style”……）本身就像一部微型思想史。文章借历年考题的幽默双关，审视这场考试的神话、偏见与副作用：七年“无附加条件”的闲散，是恩赐还是诅咒？学习重点：dichotomy、recondite、formidable 等高阶词，以及 To do A is to do B、less a blessing than a curse 等写作金句。

theme_words.meaning_zh: 平等主义的；平等主义者

paragraphs.text: At times the words feel almost random. The 1928 paper offered “Time”; the 1956 one “Islands”; 2006, “Water”. At other times the single-word essay titles that All Souls College, Oxford put in its entrance exams might have felt more [[pertinent]]. In 1990, for instance, the paper offered students—or perhaps demanded of them—“Memory”. Sometimes the exam was preeningly self-referential. In 1952 it asked students to write about “Oxford”; in 1948 it stylishly offered the single word “Style” on an otherwise almost blank page. Less stylishly, it repeated that in 2005, which rather lacked “Originality” (1932).
paragraphs.zh: 有些时候，这些词让人觉得几乎是随机的。1928 年的试卷出了“时间”；1956 年是“岛屿”；2006 年是“水”。另一些时候，牛津全灵学院入学考试里的单字作文题，可能让人觉得切题得多。比如 1990 年，试卷“给出”——或者更准确说是“要求”——学生写“记忆”。有时这场考试还带着几分得意的自指色彩：1952 年它让学生写“牛津”；1948 年它潇洒地在一张几乎空白的纸上写下“风格”二字。不太潇洒的是，2005 年它把这道题又出了一遍——这可相当缺乏 1932 年考题所说的“原创性”。

words.note_zh: = relevant/apposite；pertinent to the question 切题
preeningly self-referential 得意洋洋地自指（考题写“Oxford”“Style”）
与下句 Less stylishly 形成反讽对比；名词 style
an otherwise almost blank page 一张除此之外几乎空白的纸

sentences.text: At other times the single-word essay titles that All Souls College, Oxford put in its entrance exams might have felt more pertinent.

structure.text: the single-word essay titles ... might have felt more pertinent —— 主句：这些单字作文题可能让人觉得切题得多
that All Souls College, Oxford put in its entrance exams —— 定语从句修饰 titles
might have felt 表“本可能让人觉得”，带虚拟意味；括号里的年份+标题是全文双关梗，读时当作作者的旁批

sentences.tip_zh: 阅读技巧：本文每个引号里的标题都是考题名，作者拿它们当形容词/名词玩双关（如 lacked “Originality”），注意体会。

paragraphs.text: The All Souls entrance exam, which this year finished on October 1st, has been called the “hardest exam in the world” and “the SAS of academia”. Each year over 100 students, most of them recent graduates of Oxford, sit its four papers (two general, two specialist), each lasting three hours, over the course of two days. Two students alone will win the glittering prize of a seven-year fellowship at the college. Depending on your view, the exam is either a demanding tool to distinguish “Genius” (1935) or an intellectual “Error” (1993).
paragraphs.zh: 全灵学院的入学考试（今年于 10 月 1 日结束）被称为“世上最难的考试”和“学术界的 SAS 特种部队”。每年有 100 多名学生——多为牛津应届毕业生——参加它的四份试卷（两份综合、两份专业），每份三小时，共考两天。最终只有两人能赢得那耀眼的奖赏：学院的七年研究员职位。视你的看法而定，这场考试要么是甄别“天才”（1935 年考题）的严苛工具，要么本身就是一场智力“错误”（1993 年考题）。

words.note_zh: 英式用法 = take an exam；sit four papers 参加四场考试
a glittering prize 耀眼的奖赏；a glittering career 辉煌的 career

words.meaning_zh: （学院）研究员职位；研究员基金
words.note_zh: seven-year fellowship 七年研究员职位；fellow = 研究员/院士
a demanding tool/teacher/job 严苛的工具/老师/工作

sentences.text: Depending on your view, the exam is either a demanding tool to distinguish “Genius” (1935) or an intellectual “Error” (1993).

structure.text: Depending on your view —— 分词短语置于句首：“视你的看法而定”
the exam is either a demanding tool ... or an intellectual “Error” —— either ... or ... 二分评价结构
to distinguish “Genius” —— 不定式说明工具用途

sentences.tip_zh: 写作迁移：Depending on your view, X is either A or B. 一句话呈现争议双方；结尾再用考题名双关收束，幽默感拉满。

paragraphs.text: A similar [[dichotomy]] dogs the college. It is variously seen as either the brainiest and grandest of the grand and brainy Oxbridge colleges, or as a [[snooty]] backwater where “the best brains of Oxford are preserved—in alcohol”. Whereas other colleges churn out celebrities (Boris Johnson went to Balliol) or are celebrities themselves (Christ Church starred in “Harry Potter”), All Souls is more [[recondite]]. A sign in its porters’ lodge informs “Harry Potter Fans” that they have “come to the wrong place”, tacitly implying that to have done so is sheer “Vulgarity” (1947). Cambridge dons used to refer to All Souls as “Arseholes”, which is yet to be used as an essay title.
paragraphs.zh: 一种类似的二元对立也纠缠着这所学院。它时而被视为牛剑众多显赫学院中最聪明、最气派的一所；时而又被看作势利的死水一潭——“牛津最优秀的大脑都保存在这里——用酒精保存”。别的学院盛产名人（鲍里斯·约翰逊出自贝利奥尔学院），或自己就是名人（基督堂学院在《哈利·波特》里出镜），全灵学院则要冷僻深奥得多。学院门房里挂着一块告示，告知“哈利·波特粉丝们”他们“来错了地方”，言下之意是来错了地方纯属 1947 年考题所说的“庸俗”。剑桥的学究们过去常拿谐音把全灵学院叫作“Arseholes”（粗话谐音），这词还从未被用作作文题。

words.note_zh: a dichotomy between A and B；文中指两种对立评价“狗一样纠缠”（dog 作动词=困扰）

words.meaning_zh: 困扰，纠缠（问题如影随形）
words.note_zh: problems/doubts dog sb/sth 问题缠身；新闻英语高频动词
= haughty/supercilious（口语色彩）；a snooty backwater 势利的死水潭
recondite knowledge/subjects 冷僻的学问；GRE 级词汇
tacitly imply 含蓄暗示；tacit agreement 默契/默认

sentences.text: Whereas other colleges churn out celebrities (Boris Johnson went to Balliol) or are celebrities themselves (Christ Church starred in “Harry Potter”), All Souls is more recondite.

structure.text: Whereas other colleges churn out celebrities ... or are celebrities themselves —— whereas 引导对比状语：“而……却”
All Souls is more recondite —— 主句：全灵学院要冷僻得多
括号内两个举例（Boris Johnson / Christ Church）是杂志体插入注释，读主干时可先跳过

sentences.tip_zh: churn out = 大量炮制（略带贬义）。Whereas 对比 + 括号插例是《经济学人》标志性节奏，写作可模仿括号注释法。

paragraphs.text: Much of the college’s [[mystique]] comes from its exam. This is ironic, because its intention was the opposite. In the mid-Victorian era, British intellectuals were seized by the novel idea that brains, not breeding, should determine success. Britain, in other words, should be run by an intellectual aristocracy chosen by open competition, not an actual one. One result of this “Revolution” (1926) was the All Souls exam. Another was the entrance test for the Indian civil service. The descendants of both, to this day, are called “the hardest exam in the world”. And though created with [[egalitarian]] ideals in mind, both have been accused of “Prejudice” (1961).
paragraphs.zh: 这所学院的神秘感很大程度上来自它的考试。这颇具讽刺意味，因为考试的初衷恰恰相反。维多利亚时代中期，英国知识界被一个新颖观念攫住：决定成败的应当是才智，而非出身。换言之，英国应当由一场公开竞选出的“知识贵族”来治理，而不是真正的世袭贵族。这场“革命”（1926 年考题）的一个结果就是全灵考试；另一个结果是印度文官系统的入学考试。两者的后裔至今仍被称为“世上最难的考试”。而且，尽管都怀揣 1961 年考题所说的“平等”理想而生，两者也都被指控犯有“偏见”（同样是 1961 年考题）。

words.note_zh: the mystique of sth ……的神秘光环；形容词 mysterious
brains, not breeding 才智而非出身；a person of good breeding 教养良好
an intellectual aristocracy 知识贵族（文中构想的精英治国）

words.meaning_zh: 平等主义的；平等主义者
words.note_zh: egalitarian ideals 平等理想；equality 的形容词化
be seized by a novel idea 被新想法攫住；比 be interested in 强烈

sentences.text: In the mid-Victorian era, British intellectuals were seized by the novel idea that brains, not breeding, should determine success.

structure.text: British intellectuals were seized by the novel idea —— 主句：知识界被一个新颖观念攫住
that brains, not breeding, should determine success —— 同位语从句解释 idea 内容
not breeding 插入语形成对比：“是才智，不是出身”

sentences.tip_zh: the idea that + 从句（同位语）+ A, not B, should ... 对比强调，是议论文立论的高分骨架。

paragraphs.text: Not without cause. To read the All Souls papers is to take soil samples of antique attitudes. The 1857 paper asks testily about the “chief obstacles” to the “civilisation” of India. The 1866 exam demanded an essay on “The Government of Subject races”. There are moments of self-awareness: the 1871 paper asked students about “the effect of the spirit of their age upon standard histories”. By the 1980s that spirit had changed: 1987’s paper offered “Race”.
paragraphs.zh: 这话不无道理。读全灵学院的试卷，就像是在为陈年旧观念采集土壤样本。1857 年的试卷暴躁地问及印度“文明化”的“主要障碍”；1866 年的考试要求写一篇《论被统治种族的治理》。也有自我觉察的时刻：1871 年的试卷让学生思考“他们所处时代的精神对标准史学的影响”。到了 1980 年代，那种精神变了：1987 年的试卷给出了“种族”。

words.note_zh: testily = impatiently；形容词 testy（易怒的）
chief obstacles to …… 的主要障碍；obstacle to success 成功的绊脚石
moments of self-awareness 自我觉察的时刻；反义 self-delusion
= Zeitgeist（德语借词）；the spirit of their age

sentences.text: To read the All Souls papers is to take soil samples of antique attitudes.

structure.text: To read the All Souls papers is to take soil samples of antique attitudes —— 不定式作主语 + 不定式作表语
soil samples of antique attitudes 比喻：把考题当“土壤样本”，检测陈年观念的成分

sentences.tip_zh: 金句句式：To do A is to do B（做 A 就是做 B）。写作中用于下定义、打比方，一击即中。

paragraphs.text: However, much of the hype around the exam is mere mythology, and the college has made efforts to demystify it. In 2010 it ditched the one-word paper (partly because it was forbidding; mostly because it was bad at differentiating candidates). This pleased almost no one: now the exam is simultaneously accused of favouring the middle class and of wokery. Though that could, of course, be down to “Envy” (1998). Whatever the changes, the exam undoubtedly remains [[formidable]]. Shortlisted candidates are cross-examined by around 70 college fellows in their gowns. They are “draped”, says Armand D’Angour, a professor at Jesus College who took the exam in 1983, “around the room like vampire bats”.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，围绕这场考试的种种炒作多半只是神话，学院也一直在努力祛魅。2010 年，它废除了单字作文题（部分因为它令人生畏，主要因为它难以区分考生水平）。这几乎没让任何人满意：如今这场考试同时被指责“偏袒中产阶级”和“政治正确过头”。当然，这些指责也可能只是出于 1998 年考题所说的“嫉妒”。无论怎么改，这场考试无疑依然令人生畏。入围者要接受约 70 名学院研究员的盘问，研究员们身着长袍。用 1983 年参加过该考试的耶稣学院教授阿曼德·丹古尔的话说，他们“像吸血蝙蝠一样挂满房间四周”。

words.note_zh: much of the hype is mere mythology 多数炒作只是神话；media hype 媒体炒作
= get rid of；ditch a plan/idea/subject 废除计划/想法/科目

words.meaning_zh: 令人生畏的，望而却步的
words.note_zh: 注意与 forbid 的分词关系；a forbidding appearance/silence 令人生畏的外表/沉默
differentiate A from B 区分 A 与 B；= tell apart
法律语境：对证人交叉盘问；面试/答辩也常用

sentences.text: They are “draped”, says Armand D’Angour, a professor at Jesus College who took the exam in 1983, “around the room like vampire bats”.

structure.text: They are “draped” ... “around the room like vampire bats” —— 主句被引语拆成两段，制造节奏悬念
says Armand D’Angour, a professor ... who took the exam in 1983 —— 引用来源作插入语，内含 who 定语从句

sentences.tip_zh: 修辞亮点：明喻 like vampire bats（像吸血蝙蝠）画面感极强；引用拆两段（draped ... around the room）是英文特写的常见笔法。

paragraphs.text: A better question than “Is it woke” is “Does it work?” Does it produce the “intellectual aristocracy” that it was meant to? The list of its alumni drawn from the past 500 years is undoubtedly impressive. It includes Christopher Wren, Isaiah Berlin and, in the modern day, Sir John Vickers, an economist, and Katherine Rundell, a children’s writer. Then again, other colleges have produced far bigger hitters. A far-from-complete list of impressive alumni from nearby Balliol College, for instance, includes Adam Smith, Herbert Asquith and Aldous Huxley.
paragraphs.zh: 比“它是否政治正确”更好的问题是：“它奏效吗？”它培养出原本想培养的“知识贵族”了吗？它过去 500 年的校友名单无疑令人印象深刻：克里斯托弗·雷恩、以赛亚·柏林，以及现代的经济学家约翰·维克斯爵士、儿童文学作家凯瑟琳·朗德尔。不过话说回来，别的学院出过更重量级的人物。比如隔壁贝利奥尔学院的优秀校友名单远未穷尽：亚当·斯密、赫伯特·阿斯奎斯、阿道司·赫胥黎……

words.note_zh: 单数 alumnus（男）/ alumna（女）；alumni list 校友名单
体育引申：far bigger hitters 更重量级的人物

words.meaning_zh: 不过话说回来（转折补充）
words.note_zh: 口语连接词，用于提出反面考虑 = on the other hand
连字符复合形容词：a far-from-complete list 远非完整的名单

sentences.text: A far-from-complete list of impressive alumni from nearby Balliol College, for instance, includes Adam Smith, Herbert Asquith and Aldous Huxley.

structure.text: A far-from-complete list ... includes Adam Smith, Herbert Asquith and Aldous Huxley —— 主句：一份远未穷尽的名单就包括……
far-from-complete —— 连字符复合形容词作前置定语；for instance 为插入语

sentences.tip_zh: 两招可模仿：① far-from-complete 连字符形容词（谦逊中见分量）；② 人名三人排比收尾，举例即气势。

paragraphs.text: A more serious problem is that passing the All Souls exam offers bright scholars seven years of [[idleness]], since their prize fellowships come with almost no strings attached. This may be less a blessing than a curse. All Souls skims the cream from other Oxford colleges (historically, only those with the very best first-class degrees were encouraged to sit it) then lets it curdle. Its atmosphere, wrote A.N. Wilson, a historian, was that of a “club more than a college” and the “ruin of many of the fellows”. The 1938 All Souls paper wondered “Are examinations an evil?” A better question might have been: is this one?
paragraphs.zh: 一个更严重的问题是：通过全灵考试等于给聪明学者发了七年的闲散，因为他们的研究员奖金几乎不附带任何条件。这与其说是恩赐，不如说是诅咒。全灵学院从其他牛津学院挑走最优秀的人（历史上，只有拿到最顶尖一等学位的学生才会被鼓励应考），然后任由他们发馊变质。历史学家 A.N. 威尔逊写道，这里的氛围“更像俱乐部而非学院”，是“许多研究员的毁灭之地”。1938 年的全灵试卷曾问：“考试是恶魔吗？”更好的问题或许是：这场考试是吗？

words.note_zh: seven years of idleness 七年的闲散；idle 形容词；反义 industriousness

words.meaning_zh: 撇取奶油=挑走最优秀的人/物
words.note_zh: = skim off the cream；skim the cream from other colleges 从各院挑走尖子
lets it curdle 任其发馊——接着 cream 的比喻往下说，妙
with no strings attached 不附带任何条件；常用于福利/赠品

words.word: less a blessing than a curse
words.meaning_zh: 与其说是福，不如说是祸
words.note_zh: less A than B 结构：与其……不如……

sentences.text: A more serious problem is that passing the All Souls exam offers bright scholars seven years of idleness, since their prize fellowships come with almost no strings attached.

structure.text: A more serious problem is that ... —— 主句 + 表语从句：更严重的问题是……
passing the All Souls exam offers bright scholars seven years of idleness —— 动名词作主语；offer sb sth 双宾语结构
since their prize fellowships come with almost no strings attached —— since 引导原因；no strings attached 无附加条件

sentences.tip_zh: offer sb sth（给某人某物）双宾语 + since 原因从句 + no strings attached 固定搭配，一句话三个考点。

paragraphs.text: Perhaps. But then what, as the 2025 general paper asked, “is regret good for?” The All Souls exam might be flawed and it might suffer from “Bias” (2003). But it is also magnificent fun, pondering such things as: “What sort of book might Satan write?” (2024). Which surely brings everyone a little “Happiness” (1953).
paragraphs.zh: 也许吧。但话说回来——2025 年综合卷问得好——“后悔有什么好处？”全灵考试可能有缺陷，也可能患有 2003 年考题所说的“偏见”。但它也妙趣横生，让人思考诸如“撒旦会写一本什么样的书？”（2024 年考题）这样的问题。这想必给每个人都带来了一点 1953 年考题所说的“幸福”。

words.note_zh: flaw（缺陷）+ -ed；a flawed plan/argument 有缺陷的计划/论证
suffer from bias 带有偏见；形容词 biased
= contemplate/muse over；ponder such things as … 思考诸如……的问题
magnificent fun 妙趣横生（口语夸张）；a magnificent view 壮观景色

sentences.text: But it is also magnificent fun, pondering such things as: “What sort of book might Satan write?” (2024).

structure.text: it is also magnificent fun —— 主句：它也妙趣横生（it is fun + 名词化表达）
pondering such things as: “...” —— 分词短语表伴随；such as 后接冒号引语举例

sentences.tip_zh: 结尾技巧：it is fun doing sth + such as 冒号引语，最后再以考题“Happiness”（1953）收束全文——首尾所有引号都是考题，一篇文章就是一场考试。

background.title_zh: 全灵学院与“世上最难的考试”
background.body_zh: 全灵学院（All Souls College）1438 年由亨利六世创建，是牛津唯一一所以研究为主的学院：没有本科生，只有研究员（fellows）。其入学考试（ Examination Fellowship）创设于 1857 年，每年从 100 多名应考者中录取 0-2 人，获七年研究员职位。标志性的一词作文题（1932-2009 年）只给一个词（如“Style”“Memory”），要求写一篇结构完整的论文，被戏称为“学术界的 SAS”。2010 年起改为选题作文。

background.title_zh: 文化背景：“知识贵族”与印度文官考试
background.body_zh: 维多利亚时代中期，英国推动“凭才智而非出身”的用人革命：1854 年《麦考利报告》后建立的印度文官考试（ICS）与全灵考试并称两大“最难考试”，都试图以公开竞争选拔精英，也都长期被批评带有阶层、种族偏见。文中反复出现的括号标题是历年考题——作者拿它们当双关词用（如缺乏“Originality”、被“Bias”困扰），读出这层幽默是理解本文文风的关键。

expressions.usage_zh: 呈现争议的中立开场：Depending on your view, X is either A or B.
churn out celebrities/graduates/books 批量产出名人/毕业生/书

expressions.expr: To do A is to do B
expressions.zh: 做 A 就是做 B（定义/比喻句式）
expressions.usage_zh: 下定义一击即中：To read the papers is to take soil samples of antique attitudes.

expressions.expr: less a blessing than a curse
expressions.zh: 与其说是福，不如说是祸
expressions.usage_zh: less A than B 结构；评价事物双刃剑
福利/机会类话题高频：prize fellowships come with almost no strings attached
教育/人才话题：All Souls skims the cream from other Oxford colleges.

quiz.q: Why was the one-word essay paper dropped in 2010?
options: Because it had run unchanged since 1928.
Partly because it was forbidding, and mostly because it was bad at differentiating candidates.
Because it was accused of favouring the middle class.
quiz.explanation_zh: 第六段括号内说得很清楚：部分是因为它令人生畏（forbidding），主要是因为它难以区分考生水平（bad at differentiating candidates）。A 时间线错误（2010 年废除，非 1928 起不变）；C 是废止后出现的另一种指责；D 张冠李戴——2005 年重复的是“Style”（1948），而“Originality”是 1932 年考题，作者拿来讽刺这次重复。

quiz.q: The word “dichotomy” (Paragraph 3) is closest in meaning to ______.
options: a sharp division into two contrasting things
quiz.explanation_zh: dichotomy = 二分法、截然对立。文中指对学院的两种对立评价：要么是“最聪明最显赫”，要么是“势利的死水潭”。动词 dog 在此意为“纠缠、困扰”。

quiz.q: What is the “more serious problem” with the exam, according to the article?
options: It is accused of wokery and of favouring the middle class.
Winning brings seven years of nearly unconditional idleness that can ruin fellows.
Its alumni list is less impressive than Balliol’s.
quiz.explanation_zh: 第八段：更严重的问题是七年“无附加条件”的闲散——“less a blessing than a curse”，甚至“the ruin of many of the fellows”。A、B 是文中提到的其他争议/玩笑；D 是第七段的对比，非“更严重的问题”。

quiz.q: Their prize fellowships come with almost no strings ______ (attach).
quiz.explanation_zh: no strings attached 固定搭配：“无附加条件”。attached 过去分词作后置修饰，come with sth attached 结构（附带某物而来）。

discussion_zh: 你参加过“最难的考试”吗？一场好的考试应该考察什么能力？
文章说大奖“与其说是福，不如说是祸”（less a blessing than a curse）。如何看待“重赏之下”的副作用？
“To read the All Souls papers is to take soil samples of antique attitudes.”考题如何反映时代价值观？请举例（如高考作文题的变迁）。

writing.title_zh: 写作练习：Are examinations an evil?
writing.prompt_zh: 假定你是李华，校英文报就“考试是否是恶魔”征文。请写一篇 150 词左右的短评：1）简述全灵学院考试之争；2）分析考试的利与弊；3）表明你的观点。至少使用 2 个本文学到的表达（如 To do A is to do B / less a blessing than a curse / come with no strings attached / Depending on your view）。
